size_basis: 2 x 5 kg/d-class bins in one frame at the 8.21 kg/d wet feedstock (A-M-418 revision) (X-FARM sec3)

design.organisms: Hermetia illucens (black soldier fly) larvae: 5 instars, 14-18 d at 25-30 C; adults do not feed or bite
design.conversion: 1.4-2.0 kg wet biowaste per kg fresh larvae (TECHTREE insect-farming); substrate moisture 65-75 %
design.heat: the larvae mass generates metabolic heat (the bin self-heats; above 40 C kills the larvae)

nozzles.service: poultry manure to the larvae bin
fish sludge to the larvae bin
larvae meal to the layer ration
frass compost to the solids line
galley biowaste to the larvae bin
duck manure to the larvae bin
dried larvae meal to the layer formulation
screenings/fines back to the larvae bin
fresh larvae to the formulation drier

material: HDPE tray bin, PP larval self-harvest ramp, SS316 mesh screen; no metal below the substrate line
holds: no AQS-PLAN-006 section 4 route class for class bsfl_bin

envelope.basis: 2 x 5 kg/d-class bins in one frame at the 8.21 kg/d wet feedstock (A-M-418 revision) (X-FARM sec3)

layout.frame: origin at the frame corner; tray 2500 x 900 x 700 outer, walls and floor 10 mm; centre divider at x 1250 splits the frame into two 5 kg/d-class bins
layout.supports: frame plinth to the slab on 4 base anchors; screens clamped to the rim
layout.nozzle_spread: the schedule gives face and height only; inlet rows on the -Y wall at z 160, outlet rows on the +Y wall at z 600, drain at the base centreline, vent at the top centreline; per-tag positions in check.nozzles_drawn
layout.hardware_idiom: connection hardware flush at the envelope faces; no metal below the substrate line
